issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors on dashboard page - 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' repeated 7 times, causing entire root to switch to client rendering. Likely caused by dynamic date/time rendering (e.g., 'Good evening, Amelia.' greeting uses time-of-day which differs between server and client render, and 'Thursday, April 16' date).
issues.element: Greeting text and/or date display in dashboard page
issues.root_cause: The greeting ('Good evening') and/or date ('Thursday, April 16') are computed at render time using new Date() or similar, producing different values between SSR and client hydration. Also 'Invalid or unexpected token' error may indicate a syntax error in the page file.

issues.description: Style Profile section with radar chart is missing from the visible dashboard — expected per spec but not shown in screenshot.
issues.root_cause: Either the component is not rendered, is hidden below the fold (scroll required), or failed to mount due to the hydration error causing client-only rendering fallback.

issues.description: design/step-5 route returns 404, causing Fast Refresh fallback to browser navigation. Not directly visible on dashboard but logged as error.
issues.root_cause: apps/web/app/design/step-5/page.tsx is missing or was deleted during a rebuild.

fixes.reason: Replacing time-of-day greeting with a static greeting eliminates the SSR/client mismatch that causes hydration errors, since 'Good evening' depends on the current hour at render time.

If the date is hardcoded as a string it will mismatch on other days; wrapping in suppressHydrationWarning or making it client-only is safer. However if it is already dynamic, the real fix is to suppress the warning on that element.

Adding suppressHydrationWarning to the date/greeting paragraph elements prevents React from throwing hydration errors for dynamic time-based content that legitimately differs between server and client.
